competitor_and_territorial_scope.contract_reading: The queue requires complete relevant source competitors and territorial exclusions. The stock wrapper accepts explicit negative families but does not require a universal whole-world family census. Existing point-census and geographically justified GRD/LCA/BRB screen should be described precisely and together as bounded evidence; do not claim all possible sources worldwide were excluded.
competitor_and_territorial_scope.unresolved_limit: The competitor closure itself says the named three-family screen is finite and is not a proof against every unnamed or unsupplied source. This is not by itself a reason to require a global census beyond the contract; any packet must state the bounded scope and avoid claiming universal absence.

assessment.positive_path: The retained source-to-owner identity, six-parish government support, exact original interval/source joins, all-633 land physical witness, zero native-key overlap with preserved Saint George/Grenadines issue geometry, and stock constructor assignment are a coherent positive path for these 633 exact native cells under the original repair contract. They do not qualify the complete six feature geometries or the 389-cell companion.
assessment.remaining_exact_publication_check: Before final review, verify the candidate visibly carries the ODbL/source attribution, binds the constructor and physical receipt, preserves both whole-target issue records and their zero-key overlap result, scopes the three-family screen correctly, and does not call the constructor summary root acceptance or final selected-product approval.
assessment.no_blanket_gate: The original contract does not name an all-world source census or universal current-government certificate. The actual question is source applicability and relevant competitor coverage for this package; evidence should address those without inventing a universal certificate requirement.
